name: Guild-Militant
summary: Guild-Militant; When you hit a creature marked by Oath-Mark, one ally within 30 ft gains +1 to hit that creature before your next turn.  Guild-Militant; When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, you may use your reaction to let that ally add +1d6 damage.  Guild-Militant; When you mark a target with Oath-Mark, allies gain +1 to damage against it until your next turn.  Guild-Militant; When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, they may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

Guild-Militant; When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, they may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.
